exposure: maternal primary cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection during pregnancy
outcome: concordance rate between US and MRI
false negative rates for US and MRI
false positive/inconclusive results for US and MRI
cohort: Eighty-one women were included in the study, consisting of 48 with CMV-infected fetuses (Group 1) and 33 with maternal infection but a negative postnatal fetal CMV urine analysis (Group 2).
finding: Adding MRI in CMV-infected cases with a normal neurosonographic follow-up should be weighed against a nonnegligible rate of false positive and inconclusive findings, with a 78% concordance rate between US and MRI in Group 1.
